stories.title: Spain's World Cup final hero Ferran Torres closes in on PSG transfer
stories.summary: Paris Saint-Germain have reached an agreement with Barcelona to sign Ferran Torres, according to reports in French and Spanish outlets on Thursday evening. The forward, who scored the match-winner for Spain in the World Cup final, is expected to sign with the European champions for around €50 million.
stories.post: 📰 NEWS: Spain's World Cup final hero Ferran Torres closes in on PSG transfer. Paris Saint-Germain have reached an agreement with Barcelona to sign Ferran Torres, according to reports in French and Spanish outlets on Thursday evening. Source: France 24.
